source.persistence: disposable loopback PostgreSQL and local filesystem registry state

fixture.ownerFixtureSupport: Ben Acme remained owner in Switch Beta while Alice was changed to reader; no external account or payment provider was used.

ownerRoleAndSwitchReadback.observed: The same signed-in Alice session read Switch Alpha as owner, then Switch Beta as reader, then restored Switch Alpha as owner and Switch Beta as reader through the company selector. GET /v1/me returned the corresponding role on each switch.

alphaCatalogIsolation.observed: Switch Alpha displayed one @alpha/switch-skill release and no @beta/switch-skill text.

alphaPackIsolation.observed: Switch Alpha displayed one @alpha/switch-pack and no @beta/switch-pack text.

alphaDraftIsolation.observed: As Switch Alpha owner, the editable draft view displayed @alpha/switch-draft and no @beta/switch-draft text.

betaCatalogIsolation.observed: After switching to Switch Beta reader, the catalog displayed one @beta/switch-skill release and no @alpha/switch-skill text.

betaPackIsolation.observed: After switching to Switch Beta reader, the packs view displayed one @beta/switch-pack and no @alpha/switch-pack text.

crossCompanyDraftDenial.observed: As Switch Beta reader, direct draft URLs for both the Beta fixture and the Alpha fixture rendered Upload draft unavailable without exposing either draft label.

readerBillingDenial.observed: As Alice reader in Switch Beta, direct /app/billing rendered the server denial Owner or admin access is required for company billing; GET /v1/billing returned HTTP 403 with code BILLING_FORBIDDEN.

mobileCompanySelector.observed: The compact header exposed an accessible Company combobox with Switch Alpha and Switch Beta options; selecting Alpha showed Switch Alpha content and owner role, and selecting Beta restored Switch Beta content and reader role. The selector measured 112x32 CSS pixels.

browserErrors.observed: agent-browser console and page-error reads were empty after the exercised routes.

validation.result: Passed authenticated headless route, selector, role, API, content-isolation, mobile viewport, screenshot, console, and page-error checks described above.

limits: This is a local synthetic identity and LocalBillingAdapter proof only; no Stripe account, remote provider, customer, product, price, payment method, charge, or production database was contacted.
The inert catalog and pack fixtures used scanner-disabled local policy state and do not establish scanner safety or commercial launch readiness.
The proof covers two companies and one signed-in human; hosted deployment, real provider checkout, external identity, scanner/LLM execution, and production acceptance remain outside this record.
Screenshot paths are local ephemeral artifacts and are not a hosted product record.
